description: Flux Innovation Lounge opens its doors for Open House Festival, inviting visitors to explore where physical, virtual and immersive worlds meet. Described as one of London’s most celebrated creative venues and a hotbed for innovation and technology, Flux is a working innovation space where ideas are tested, experienced and brought to life. Join us to discover the future of the built environment.

factsheet.heading: About Flux Innovation Lounge
paragraphs: Located in the heart of Greenwich Design District, Flux Innovation Lounge is an immersive innovation space where architecture, storytelling and technology come together to shape the future of human experience.

Designed and operated by creative technology studio Engage Works, Flux serves as a living innovation space for exploring how physical and digital environments can work together. The space brings together a range of emerging technologies, including interactive displays, large-scale LED environments, real-time virtual worlds, AI-powered experiences, spatial computing and collaborative software, to demonstrate new ways of communicating complex ideas.

Unlike a traditional exhibition space, Flux is a working environment used by brands, agencies, architects, developers and cultural organisations to prototype, test, experience and workshop ideas before they are brought into the real world. From immersive visitor experiences and innovation centres to digital twins and collaborative workshops, the technologies on display are actively used to design tomorrow's spaces and experiences.

Normally only accessible by appointment, Open House Festival offers a rare opportunity to step inside Flux and explore the technologies transforming how we learn, collaborate, present and interact with the built environment.

Throughout the festival, visitors can explore the space through guided demonstrations and informal talks with the Engage Works team. You'll discover how physical spaces can become interactive, responsive and immersive, and gain an insight into the creative and technical disciplines behind experience design.

-Guided tours of Flux Innovation Lounge.
-Live demonstrations of immersive technologies and interactive environments.
-Opportunities to experience AI-powered storytelling, digital twins and collaborative software.
-Informal conversations with designers, technologists and creative specialists about the future of the built environment and immersive experience design.
Whether you're interested in architecture, technology, design or simply curious about how London's spaces are evolving, Flux offers a unique glimpse into the future of experience-led environments.
